clearance_basis: Two 160-MU dry walkways flank a 64-MU, 16-deep channel. Each walkway exceeds three maximum player diameters (128 MU); level crossings and open gates provide 384 MU. Endpoint-cell and refuge routes use the same clearance. Existing supported player and prisoner collision sizes are unchanged.
gate_rule: Transparent barred rendering with native closed movement, Use, hitscan, projectile and AI-sight blocking. Accepted runtime sight blocking keeps the boss from alerting through the closed arena gate. Keys open permanently without consumption.
cardinal_spacing_basis: Author requested minimum-length hub approaches on 2026-10-02. Entry distance = half the junction grid span + room width + one collision-grid cell. Adjacent section floors retain exactly one 32-MU solid wall strip; no overlap or unintended connection.
